name: Let us read
core_idea: I “Who put that water bag here?” roared my father from the front doorstep.
supporting_evidence: “Your burglar alarm,” I hissed to my brother Anand, who was getting ready to disappear from the house.
Ma rushed in to see what the racket was all about and found Papa standing there, sopping wet and scowling.

name: Let us learn
core_idea: I Read the highlighted word in the following sentence.
supporting_evidence: The moment the door opens, this alarm is tripped off and makes a clanging sound.

name: Let us explore
core_idea: Creativity is ‘thinking new things’; innovation is ‘doing new things’ and an invention is ‘bringing ideas or objects together in a novel way to create something that did not exist before’.
supporting_evidence: Human beings are naturally very curious and creative, and this has led to many scientific and technological inventions.
You must have heard about many famous inventions.
